A Click'n'Load click no longer opens a tab you did not ask for.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Clicking a Click'n'Load button opened the extension's options page in a new tab** whenever this browser had no connection phrase stored — which is every browser that has just had the extension re-added, since that resets its storage. The send path called `openOptionsPage()`, and with `open_in_tab` that is a tab, arriving on a click somebody aimed at a download button. The popup had already learned exactly this lesson and says so in its own comment ("it hijacked the click and took you somewhere you had not asked to go"); the same mistake sat one function away the whole time. The popup opens instead, and its own not-connected state offers Options as a button you press on purpose.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The options page carries its version.** Build plus GlimStone, the same quiet line the web interface puts at the bottom of every settings tab. The number was previously only reachable inside the diagnostic report, which is a box you have to open first — so from the page itself the extension appeared to have no version at all.

## 📋 Notes

- If a Click'n'Load click still does something unexpected, check the version on `chrome://extensions` first: an unpacked extension keeps the code it was loaded with until it is reloaded.
